audit_items.proof_trace: ValidFields checks array length consistency but not size limits. An attacker could send a data column with len(Column)=len(Commitments)=len(Proofs)=1M, passing ValidFields but causing memory exhaustion during batch KZG verification array allocation (lines 68-71).
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker sends P2P data column message with massive but equal-length arrays (e.g., 10^6 cells). ValidFields passes as lengths match, but lines 68-71 allocate gigabytes of memory for commitments/indices/cells/proofs arrays before KZG verification, causing OOM.
